pr_comments:
So in `_get_ready_tis` we’re basically moving expanded tasks from _ready_ to _changed_ for one round, and instead of scheduling them right away, wait for one iteration instead so the check in `task_instance_scheduling_decisions` has a chance to move them directly to _finished_ if needed.

To match that intention I think we can move the expansion logic into the `are_dependencies_met` branch. I’ll push a commit for this later.
(Assigning myself so this shows up in my Pull Requests view. Nothing indicative.)
